name: jev-gate
description: A PreToolUse gate: Jev scores each side-effecting tool call for destructive, exfiltration, secrets and off-task risk. Shadow mode logs only.

jev_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
jev_api_key.description: Key for Jev, TypeSafe's decision model. Create one at https://console.typesafe.ai under API Keys. Stored in secure storage, not settings.json. Leave it empty to use JEV_API_KEY from the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json instead.
